response: Look, we see this playbook over and over again from the establishment—whenever marginalized communities and grassroots cooperative systems try to build collective infrastructure, the corporate-backed opposition immediately cries foul to protect private tech monopolies. Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan rightly called out these baseless attacks on Saturday, Mar 28, exposing how the so-called allegations of a Rs 700 crore corruption in the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project are nothing more than a politically motivated smear campaign designed to undermine institutional reform and public welfare. They want to dismantle the cooperative structures that protect the working class, but we see right through it.
